name: menu
description: A list of actions that opens from a button: row actions, an overflow "more" button, account menus. Put a trigger button and a Menu inside MenuTrigger, then fill the Menu with MenuItems and MenuSeparators, all exported from the menu file. Menu items run actions; to pick a value use a select. Use variant="danger" on destructive items and put them last, after a separator. To open a dialog from an item, control the dialog's isOpen from onAction. The example's Button comes from the button component.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Called with the chosen item's id; or give each MenuItem its own onAction.

props.name: disabledKeys
props.description: Ids of items that show but can't be chosen; or set isDisabled on a MenuItem.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the menu when the trigger's text doesn't describe it.
